source: Speed factors relative to the TrackMan PGA Tour averages: TrackMan's published amateur averages put a scratch golfer's driver near 105 mph, a 14-handicap near 94 mph and a 25-handicap near 85 mph (TrackMan 'Amateur averages', estimated from their charts). Dispersions (one standard deviation) are gameplay estimates chosen so that tour pros hit about 60-70 % of greens from 150 yards and higher handicaps progressively fewer. Putting scatter (which stands in for green-reading as well as stroke errors) is set so the tour profile holes 97 % from 3 ft, 61 % from 6 ft, 47 % from 10 ft, 20 % from 20 ft and 6 % from 40 ft on this course's greens, against Broadie's (2014) PGA Tour 96, 70, 40, 15 and 5 %.
